health.rule: Four tests: net debt to EBITDA below 1 (net cash counts as a pass), interest coverage above 10 (no debt counts as a pass), free cash flow positive in each of the last 3 years, current ratio above 1. All pass: Strong. One or two fail: Moderate. Three or four fail: Weak. An input the company did not report counts as a fail.

rows.label: Return on equity (ROE)
rows.definition: Net income divided by average shareholders' equity.

rows.label: Return on invested capital (ROIC)
rows.definition: Operating income after tax, divided by equity plus debt minus cash and investments.

rows.label: Return on assets (ROA)
rows.definition: Net income divided by average total assets.

rows.label: Debt to equity
rows.definition: Total debt divided by shareholders' equity.

rows.label: Net debt to EBITDA
rows.definition: Debt minus cash and investments, divided by operating income plus depreciation and amortization. Negative means net cash.

rows.label: Current ratio
rows.definition: Current assets divided by current liabilities.

rows.label: Interest coverage
rows.definition: Operating income divided by interest expense.

rows.label: Price to earnings (P/E)
rows.definition: Share price divided by diluted earnings per share, trailing twelve months.

rows.label: EV to EBITDA
rows.definition: Market value plus debt minus cash, divided by EBITDA.

rows.label: Price to sales
rows.definition: Market value divided by revenue, trailing twelve months.

rows.label: Free cash flow yield
rows.definition: Free cash flow divided by market value.

rows.label: Dividend yield
rows.definition: Dividends paid over the last twelve months, divided by market value.

scorecard.label: Market risk
scorecard.rule: Worst of two reads on 5 years of daily prices. Annualised volatility: below 25% Low, 25% to 40% Medium, above 40% High. Largest fall from a peak: below 30% Low, 30% to 50% Medium, above 50% High.

scorecard.label: Financial risk
scorecard.rule: Net debt to EBITDA: net cash or below 1 Low, 1 to 3 Medium, above 3 High. A current ratio below 1 raises the level by one step.

scorecard.label: Business risk
scorecard.rule: From the concentration the company discloses. Any customer above 25% of revenue, or one region above 70%: High. Any customer above 10%, or one region above 50%: Medium. Otherwise, or nothing disclosed: Low.

scorecard.label: Legal and regulatory risk
scorecard.rule: From the legal proceedings section of the latest annual report. Matters the company itself calls material, or a regulator's decision or fine that is pending: High. Named pending cases without that language: Medium. None beyond routine matters: Low.
scorecard.inputs: 12 named matters or regulators in the legal section
